source: Mojang official Minecraft Java Edition client JAR
verification: Downloaded client JAR SHA-1 matched official Mojang metadata before extraction. PNG bytes are unmodified.
rights: Minecraft textures belong to Mojang/Microsoft. These assets are not newly authored or licensed by this project.
usage: Original PNG files retained byte-for-byte. Runtime copies/tiles their columns at 1:1 into 182x5 rows with one segment per drafted character. The rows use integer physical-screen-pixel scaling, never horizontal stretching of source cells. The recomposed segment layout is not an unmodified vanilla HUD layout.
